title: swcollect · Topology and routing
description: Links from Orion.TopologyConnections, neighbors from LLDP and Orion.Routing.*. State names come from Orion.Routing.RoutingProtocolStateMapping, as SolarWinds publishes them. Times in tables are exactly as received from SolarWinds (server-local). Graphs place each point at the received time minus the server UTC offset measured by swcollect (sw_meta.instance.utc_offset_minutes).

list.name: instance
list.label: Orion instance
list.query: SELECT instance_key AS __text, instance_id AS __value FROM sw_meta.instance ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT instance_key AS __text, instance_id AS __value FROM sw_meta.instance ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Physical topology (sw_core.link)
panels.description: One node per device, one edge per device pair with a link whose both interfaces are in Orion. A link to an interface Orion does not hold is in the dead-letter queue instead.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d."NodeID"::text AS id, d."Caption" AS title, d."MachineType" AS subtitle, coalesce(n."StatusDescription", '') AS mainstat, d."IPAddress" AS secondarystat FROM sw_core.device d LEFT JOIN sw_raw.orion_nodes n ON n.instance_id = d.instance_id AND n."NodeID" = d."NodeID" WHERE d.instance_id = $instance AND d.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT min(l.id)::text AS id, l."SrcNodeID"::text AS source, l."DestNodeID"::text AS target, min(si."Name" || ' ↔ ' || di."Name") AS mainstat FROM sw_core.link l JOIN sw_core.interface si ON si.id = l.src_interface_id JOIN sw_core.interface di ON di.id = l.dest_interface_id WHERE l.instance_id = $instance AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l."SrcNodeID" < l."DestNodeID" GROUP BY 2, 3

panels.title: Neighbors by protocol and state
panels.description: A state without a SolarWinds mapping is shown as its code.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(rp."DisplayName", r."ProtocolID"::text) AS "Protocol", coalesce(sm."DisplayName", 'code ' || r."ProtocolStatus") AS "State", count(*) AS "Neighbors" FROM sw_core.routing_neighbor r LEFT JOIN sw_raw.orion_routing_routingprotocolstatemapping sm ON sm.instance_id = r.instance_id AND sm."ProtocolID" = r."ProtocolID" AND sm."ProtocolStatus" = r."ProtocolStatus" AND sm._deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sw_raw.orion_routing_routingprotocol rp ON rp.instance_id = r.instance_id AND rp."ProtocolID" = r."ProtocolID" AND rp._deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.instance_id = $instance AND r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

panels.title: Neighbors not in the protocol's main state
panels.description: Per protocol, every neighbor whose state is not the state most of its neighbors are in (for example a BGP session that is not Established). Rank, not a hard-coded state.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT d."Caption" FROM sw_core.device d WHERE d.instance_id = $instance AND d."NodeID" = r."NodeID" AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "Device", rp."DisplayName" AS "Protocol", r."NeighborIP" AS "Neighbor", coalesce(sm."DisplayName", 'code ' || r."ProtocolStatus") AS "State", r."LastChange" AS "Last change (as received)" FROM sw_core.routing_neighbor r LEFT JOIN sw_raw.orion_routing_routingprotocolstatemapping sm ON sm.instance_id = r.instance_id AND sm."ProtocolID" = r."ProtocolID" AND sm."ProtocolStatus" = r."ProtocolStatus" AND sm._deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sw_raw.orion_routing_routingprotocol rp ON rp.instance_id = r.instance_id AND rp."ProtocolID" = r."ProtocolID" AND rp._deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.instance_id = $instance AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND (r."ProtocolID", r."ProtocolStatus") NOT IN (SELECT x."ProtocolID", x."ProtocolStatus" FROM sw_core.routing_neighbor x WHERE x.instance_id = $instance AND x.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) = (SELECT max(c) FROM (SELECT count(*) c FROM sw_core.routing_neighbor y WHERE y.instance_id = $instance AND y.deleted_at IS NULL AND y."ProtocolID" = x."ProtocolID" GROUP BY y."ProtocolStatus") z)) ORDER BY 5 DESC

SELECT (SELECT d."Caption" FROM sw_core.device d WHERE d.instance_id = $instance AND d."NodeID" = f."NodeID" AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "Device", f."NeighborIP" AS "Neighbor", f."FlapCount" AS "Flaps" FROM sw_raw.orion_routing_neighborsflapcount f WHERE f.instance_id = $instance AND f._deleted_at IS NULL AND f."DaysBucket" = 7 AND f."FlapCount" > 0 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Route flaps (Orion.Routing.RoutingTableFlap)
panels.description: Routes that changed, as SolarWinds recorded them.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f."DateTime" AS "Time (as received)", (SELECT d."Caption" FROM sw_core.device d WHERE d.instance_id = $instance AND d."NodeID" = f."NodeId" AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "Device", f."RouteDestination" || '/' || f."CIDR" AS "Prefix", f."RouteNextHop" AS "Next hop" FROM sw_raw.orion_routing_routingtableflap f WHERE f.instance_id = $instance AND f._deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: LLDP neighbors that are not in Orion
panels.description: Neighbors seen by LLDP whose name and address match no Orion node: unmonitored equipment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT d."Caption" FROM sw_core.device d WHERE d.instance_id = $instance AND d."NodeID" = l."NodeID" AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "Device", l."LocalPort" AS "Local port", l."RemoteSystemName" AS "Remote system", l."RemotePort" AS "Remote port", l."RemoteIP" AS "Remote IP" FROM sw_core.lldp_neighbor l WHERE l.instance_id = $instance AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sw_core.node_ip_address a WHERE a.instance_id = l.instance_id AND a."IPAddress" = l."RemoteIP" AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sw_core.device d WHERE d.instance_id = l.instance_id AND d."Caption" = l."RemoteSystemName" AND d.deleted_at IS NULL)
